An independently hash-bound plan must carry the exact base/source-only/no-runtime schema; actual changed-existing and all newly inventoried source paths must exactly equal its sorted unique declared lists. Original deletion, omitted/extra changes and undeclared new source paths refuse.

Source path keys reject absolute paths, empty/dot/dot-dot components and unsafe characters; all supplied ancestors and recursively visited entries reject symlinks before physical normalization. No output may lie inside either physical source root.

Each changed file is decoded strictly as UTF8. Sequential inverse hunks expand context until after-text is unique and replay restores the complete original string; finite whole-file fallback is also verified for unique after-text and exact original bytes. Ambiguity or failed whole restoration refuses.

Rows bind immutable old/current whole-file SHA256 and ordered before/after hunks. Generation receipt binds manifest, explicit reviewed-plan pin, producer bytes, exact inverse bytes, ordered paths and all nonholder new source bytes.

The new sealholder must be a new declared file and cannot enter inverse rows; its final literal binding is explicitly deferred rather than recursively hashing itself.
